prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='THETA', seasonality_champion='NaiveSeasonal', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: THETA leads trend correlation (0.319) while NaiveSeasonal dominates seasonality (0.388), but FT_catboost achieves lowest RMSE (999.11) despite negative trend correlation. High model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio 26.56) and seasonality variance (0.75) with concept drift detected suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit component decomposition while handling autocorrelated residuals across models.
